label: Simplified VAT taxpayer threshold
appliesTo: Individual businesses. Corporations cannot use the simplified regime at all.
why: Below this line you file once a year at an effective rate of 1.5–4% instead of a flat 10%. It is the single largest structural difference in Korean VAT for a small business.

history.note: Raised from ₩80,000,000. Recorded at the date this site first verified it, not the date it changed.
